v08-la-finette-taverne-d-arbois.name: La Finette — Taverne d'Arbois
tags: The canonical Jura tavern since 1961 — varnished log tables, vaulted cellar
v08-la-finette-taverne-d-arbois.why: The canonical Jura tavern since 1961 — varnished log tables, vaulted cellar. To order: fondue de Comté (€20.50/person), poulet au Vin Jaune et morilles, Jura trout, Morteau sausage, Franche-Comté ice cream with Fougerolles cherries. Daily 11:45-14:30 and 18:45-22:30, year-round. Maximum Jura folk décor. Wines exclusively Jura.
v08-la-finette-taverne-d-arbois._lane: Wine tables — the tavern, the cave à manger, the caveau

v09-le-bistrot-des-claquets.name: Le Bistrot des Claquets
tags: Le Fooding selected — the cave à manger / natural-wine bistro of Arbois since 2010
v09-le-bistrot-des-claquets.why: Le Fooding selected — the cave à manger / natural-wine bistro of Arbois since 2010. To order: the daily-changing single main course + cold buffet (formula €12–19.50); aperitif boards with regional charcuterie and cheese. Personal natural & organic Jura wine selection — the team tastes everything before listing. Where the Jura vignerons drink lunch. AMAP farmer deliveries Tue and Wed.
v09-le-bistrot-des-claquets._lane: Wine tables — the tavern, the cave à manger, the caveau

v11-caveau-des-jacobins.name: Caveau des Jacobins
tags: Jura wine cave — sale and tasting of the seven varieties without driving
v11-caveau-des-jacobins.why: Jura wine cave — sale and tasting of the seven varieties without driving. To order: Vin Jaune Macle or Tissot; Crémant brut; Macvin for the apéritif; a vertical of Ploussard from Pupillin. For understanding the seven Jura varieties before driving up to Château-Chalon. The caviste explains without bla-bla.
v11-caveau-des-jacobins._lane: Wine tables — the tavern, the cave à manger, the caveau

v12-march-de-lons-le-saunier.name: Marché de Lons-le-Saunier
tags: The largest market in the Jura department — Thursday (main) + Saturday (food) + Wednesday (producers, 17h-19h30)
v12-march-de-lons-le-saunier.why: The largest market in the Jura department — Thursday (main) + Saturday (food) + Wednesday (producers, 17h-19h30). To order: Comté from Marcel Petite (Fort Saint-Antoine), Saucisse de Morteau IGP from a tuyé producer, cancoillotte, Mont d'Or in season, miel de sapin, eight-month Bleu de Gex. Thursday is the big market — Place du 11 Novembre (manufactured goods, all day) + Place de Verdun (food, morning). Saturday: Cours Sully food morning. Wednesday: 17:00-19:30 producers, Place du 11 Novembre.
v12-march-de-lons-le-saunier.address: Place de la Comédie + Place du 11 Novembre, 39000 Lons-le-Saunier
v12-march-de-lons-le-saunier._lane: La Rue — the market, the fromager and the chocolatier

v-fromagerie-vagne.name: Fromagerie Vagne
v-fromagerie-vagne.verdict: The fromager-affineur under the arcades: Comté at several ages side by side, Bleu de Gex, Morbier, Mont d'Or in season and cancoillotte.
v-fromagerie-vagne.signature: Comté at three ages, cut side by side.
v-fromagerie-vagne._source: old gastronomy, dish and avoid cards
v-fromagerie-vagne._lane: La Rue — the market, the fromager and the chocolatier

v10-p-tisserie-chocolaterie-pelen.name: Pâtisserie Chocolaterie Pelen
tags: Maison since 1899 — Gault & Millau listed chocolatier
v10-p-tisserie-chocolaterie-pelen.why: Maison since 1899 — Gault & Millau listed chocolatier. To order: Galet de Chalain (the praliné-and-nougatine signature, created 1984 by Dominique Pelen, named after Lac de Chalain), tarte au comté, éclair café, bean-to-bar chocolate. Arnaud Pelen, 4th generation. The Galet is the souvenir comestible to bring home. Note: address corrected — 175 rue Blaise Pascal, NOT rue du Commerce. Mon & Sat 08:00-12:00/14:30-19:00; Tue-Fri 08:30-12:00/13:45-17:30.
v10-p-tisserie-chocolaterie-pelen._lane: La Rue — the market, the fromager and the chocolatier
